concept: EFS: shared POSIX file system for many EC2 instances across AZs
tests: Choosing storage with concurrent access from many EC2 instances across multiple AZs and automatic growth.
expected: Amazon EFS — managed NFS, multi-AZ, elastic. Triggers: "shared POSIX file storage", "concurrently from many EC2", "multiple AZs", "scaling automatically".
why_not: EBS Multi-Attach — single AZ and io1/io2 only; instance store — ephemeral and local; S3 — object storage, not POSIX.
